text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-What an incredible display, Rhein 
Kraft!! First place goes to Rhein Kraft!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Having showcased her blistering speed in 
the Oka Sho and NHK Mile Cup, Line Craft 
now reigns supreme as the Queen of 
Oaksーーー!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha...!! We did it, we did itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Traineeeeer!! I did it!! I really did 
iiit--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing left to do but take my 
hat off to her. As Rine Kraft ran over, I 
gave her the messy headpat she was asking 
for.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ehehehe...!! It's totally fine to 
stir it up much more furiously, 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“My bangs aren't gonna give up from 
something like that!”
choice_data_list:
(You're right, it's definitely gonna pop 
right up!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So, yes!! Please, shower me with even 
waaay more cheers!♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all, determined not to 
concede at this distance, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...No. I was completely outrun. Her 
back... felt so far away."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...!! Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Winners and losers alike each have 
their own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "Oaks" came to a close for 
Rhein Kraft and the others...
